text: WANTED: 'BISCUIT' — BLOODTHIRSTY STEED. Approach only with apples. Reward doubled if the apples come back.
WANTED: COLE 'COPPER' CALLOWAY — sharpshooter. Armed and extremely polite. Do not offer him paperwork; he will fold it neatly.
WANTED: THE RUSTLERS — known to leave folk BETTER than they found them. Authorities describe this as 'deeply suspicious'.
LOST: ONE HAWK CALL. Answers to 'honk-a-hoo'. If heard, do not correct the boy. — Management
NOTICE: R. VEGA'S PATENTED DOOR-UNSQUEAKER — stolen (the patent, not the door). The squeak continues out of spite.
SHERIFF'S NOTICE: crime is DOWN 40%* in Copperhead Creek. (*measurement suspended pending a quieter month.)
VANE PROGRESS BULLETIN No. 47: another statue is COMING SOON to this very spot. You're welcome. — C.V.
NOT WANTED: A. CROW, 'THE KESTREL'. Too good at her job. Please stop reporting her; it only encourages the paperwork.
WANTED: THE TUMBLEWEED THAT WENT THROUGH MABEL'S WINDOW. Last seen heading everywhere. Considered rolled and dangerous.
RAILHEAD NOTICE: apples left unattended on this platform will be considered a donation. — signed, everyone who has met Biscuit
